current.text: He is a rookie from the 2026 draft class.
His dynasty rookie rank is 31. His Summer League play did not change it.
If he gets a role, he could make about 2.5 threes in 20 minutes but add almost nothing in other categories.
Minnesota's bench is thin, with little scoring punch, and the team needs wing depth in case of injuries.

durable.text: He is a pure volume three-point shooter. In Summer League, 10 of his 14 shots were threes, and he made 21% of them.
He is an older prospect. Before the draft he took a huge number of threes and made them at a high rate.
Outside of threes his projected line is very thin. Points, rebounds and steals are clear weak spots.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Only worth adding if he earns about 20 minutes. Then he is a threes-only streamer.

note: Yahoo ranks him 709th with a value of 0 USD, and ESPN gives no price. That puts him far outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not draft him. His Yahoo projection is only 0.6 threes and 3.7 points per game, and his only possible fantasy use is as a three-point streamer. Early in the season, check whether Minnesota's thin bench gives him about 20 minutes a night. If it does, he can be a short-term pickup for teams that need threes.
